# Copilot workspace instructions

> The primary project context for this repo is in `AGENTS.md` at the repo root.
> Please read that file first for project overview, tech stack, conventions,
> and active work tracking.

## Copilot-specific notes

- Agent definitions are in `.github/agents/`
- Reusable prompt files are in `.github/prompts/`
- Spec Kit commands are available for structured feature work — see `.github/`
  for installed prompt files
- Plans for in-flight work live in `.ai/plans/` — each branch has a matching
  subfolder `YYYYMMDD_branch-name/` with `PLAN.md` inside
- The index of active and completed plans is in `.ai/plans/README.md`
- On completion, write an `OUTCOME.md` in the same subfolder
- Use the `new-plan` prompt in `.github/prompts/` to scaffold a new plan
